title: SentinelMesh Fused Incident
description: One correlated incident produced by the Fusion Engine, enriched by the Forecast Module and then by Claude's API. This is the only object the Dashboard needs to render a full incident card.

created_at.description: When the Fusion Engine first created this incident.

updated_at.description: Last time a new event was folded into this incident, or the forecast/summary was refreshed. Null until first update.

linked_event_ids.description: IDs of every raw event (see event.schema.json) folded into this incident. Must contain at least 2 — a single event is not an incident.

primary_entity.description: The shared entity that caused these events to be linked. Same shape as event.entity.

locations.description: Every distinct location involved across the linked events (can be more than one — e.g. badge at door A, then camera motion in room B).

time_window.description: Start/end timestamps spanning the linked events.

correlation_reason.description: Why the Fusion Engine grouped these events together. This is what powers your dashboard's 'explain why' view.

severity.description: Incident-level severity — typically the max severity of its linked events, possibly escalated by the Forecast Module.

matched_attack_pattern.description: Name of the known attack-sequence pattern this incident matches, from the Forecast Module's pattern library. Null if no match yet.

predicted_next_step.description: Human-readable prediction of the attacker's likely next action, from the Forecast Module. Null if no pattern matched.
examples: Likely attempt to access server room within 10 minutes

confidence.description: Forecast Module's confidence in matched_attack_pattern, 0 to 1. Null if no pattern matched.

summary.description: Plain-English incident summary generated by Claude's API. Null until Claude has processed this incident.
examples: An unrecognized badge accessed the server room at 2:14 AM after two failed network logins from the same employee ID, matching a known pre-exfiltration pattern.

recommended_action.description: Recommended operator action, generated by Claude's API alongside the summary.
examples: Lock server room access and notify on-call security immediately.

status.description: Operator workflow state, shown and changed from the Dashboard.

operator_feedback.description: Set when an operator dismisses an incident. Used by the feedback loop to reduce future noise. Null otherwise.
